children: Yields on U.K. government bonds, or gilts, drop as oil prices retreat, easing concerns about inflation. Brent crude falls 0.8% to $98.45 a barrel due to prospects of a U.S.-Iran deal after Kyodo News on Tuesday reported that Iran said it would reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days if the U.S. lifts its blockade. Ten-year gilt yields fall 1.4 basis points to last trade at 5.209%, Tradeweb data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
